launch.command: python tools/run_s3_10m_engineering_probe.py --repo-root . --source-sha $(git rev-parse HEAD) --output evidence/s3-10m-gpu-pilot.json --checkpoint-root artifacts/s3-10m-gpu-pilot/checkpoints --device cuda --precision bf16 --batch-size 4 --sequence-length 1024 --optimizer-steps 256 --gradient-accumulation-steps 8 --checkpoint-every 32 --learning-rate 0.0003 --weight-decay 0.1 --seed 20260825 --cpu-threads 2

failure_recovery.non_finite_or_ambiguous_update: stop; do not continue the poisoned Trainer; restore the latest verified checkpoint into a fresh model and fresh Trainer
failure_recovery.checkpoint_failure_after_committed_step: do not blindly replay the committed step; inspect artifact failure and resume from the latest prior verified checkpoint
failure_recovery.oom: restart from latest verified checkpoint with micro_batch_size halved; preserve sequence length and raise gradient accumulation to keep effective token batch approximately constant
failure_recovery.bf16_unavailable: do not silently downgrade; stop and explicitly select fp32 or a supported accelerator

truth_boundary.data: controlled mechanics only until a reviewed S3 corpus/tokenizer decision is frozen
